summary: [standards] learn.promotion.13's unknown-strategy case never reaches the strategy lookup: it passes bad.sig, and rollback_strategy_authenticated verifies the signature (canon-learn/src/promotion/rollback.rs:76) before find_by_id (:78), so the exit-1 LEARN_ROLLBACK_FAILED it asserts is the signature failure (ran the binary: message 'ssh signature verification failed'). Deleting the UnknownStrategyId branch keeps the test green. Fix: sign a valid rollback payload for the unknown id and assert the message names the unknown strategy. Also: an unknown id exits 1 here but 2 (LEARN_STRATEGY_NOT_FOUND) in strategy approval-payload; per the brief's assumption a bug-looking exit belongs in a finding, not a pinned Then.
